description: Congressional bills and resolutions from api.congress.gov (Library of Congress), refreshed daily for the current and previous Congress. Metadata only: sponsors, text and summaries are at api_url and congress_gov_url. bill_id is '{congress}-{TYPE}-{number}', e.g. '119-HR-134'. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive: since/until on latest_action_date, introduced_* on introduction_date. Detail: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_bills

bill_type.description: HR/S bills; *RES simple, *JRES joint, *CONRES concurrent resolutions.

name: get_bills
